VehicleLog.title: VehicleLog
VehicleLog.description: Represents a two-wheeler parking entry and exit transaction with ANPR plate, photo proof, duration math, and payment audit status.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated parking stand account.

plateNumber.description: Normalized uppercase Indian vehicle registration number (e.g. TN39AB1234).

entryTimestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds when the vehicle entered the parking stand.

exitTimestamp.description: Optional epoch milliseconds when the vehicle exited the stand.

photoPath.description: Local file path to compressed snapshot with burned-in timestamp.

status.description: Current physical status of the parked two-wheeler.

paymentStatus.description: Settlement method for audit and cash drawer calculation.

baseFee.description: Base parking fee calculated for this stay.

previousCreditAdded.description: Previous unpaid credit balance added to this bill.

workerName.description: Name or role identifier of the operator who logged the entry.

notes.description: Optional audit or AI vehicle condition notes.

Pass.title: Pass
Pass.description: Represents an active or expired Weekly or Monthly parking pass linked to a license plate.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated parking stand account.

plateNumber.description: Normalized uppercase Indian vehicle registration number.

paymentMode.description: How the pass was paid for (PAID_CASH increments expected cash in drawer).

Credit.title: Credit
Credit.description: Tracks unpaid 'Pay Tomorrow' (Udhaar) credit balances linked to a vehicle license plate.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated parking stand account.

plateNumber.description: Normalized uppercase Indian vehicle registration number.

pendingAmount.description: Outstanding rupee balance owed by this vehicle.

lastUnpaidTimestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds when the credit was incurred.

notes.description: Context notes for the pending debt.

isSettled.description: Whether the pending debt has been settled.

RateConfig.title: RateConfig
RateConfig.description: Owner-controlled tariff rates, security PIN, and auto-torch luminosity threshold.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated parking stand account.

dailyRate.description: Base rate per 24-hour block in INR (default 20).

ownerPin.description: 4-to-8 digit PIN protecting Owner mode and tariff edits.

lowLightThreshold.description: Average Y-plane pixel luminance (5..200) below which auto-torch triggers.

/users/{userId}/vehicle_logs/{logId}.description: Real-time synced vehicle entry and exit logs for the parking stand.

/users/{userId}/passes/{passId}.description: Active and historical Weekly and Monthly vehicle passes.

/users/{userId}/credits/{creditId}.description: Pay Tomorrow (Udhaar) credit ledger per license plate.

/users/{userId}/config/{configId}.description: Tariff rate configuration and Owner PIN.
